input:
CURRENT SCENE:
古代的时候，有一个男孩名字叫孟子。孟子和孟子的妈妈两个人住在很穷的农村。他们住的地方旁边是个墓地，墓地老是有很多人祭拜。因为人们在祭拜，他们一直在哭。孟子和孟子的妈妈住在这里才一个星期就觉得受不了了，而且害得孟子的学习。

ITEMS:

[I27] 【古代的时候】   correction: 古代的时候 → 在古代   strength: error
  checker's note: her pattern: 古代的时候 -> 在古代 (corrected 18/30 in train)
  rule card (location_with_zai, Grammar): Use 在+Place for a location: put the location before the action as 在Place + V., or use 住在+Place. Add 里/上 when needed to make the place clear.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <place> is the location, so use 在+Place before the action.  Her terms: 在+Place, 在Place住, 住在+Place, 在Place + V., 在Place V1.着V2
  her past correction: [古代的时候→在古代]
  her past correction: [古代的时候→在古代]
  her past correction: [古代的时候→在古代]

[I28] 【^】他们一直在哭   correction: ∅ → 所以   strength: suggestion
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 但是孟子一直哭[-了] — her note: it’s not about “completion”, no了
  her past correction: [+所以]他们常常搬家 — her note: 无聊？add所以
  her past correction: 所以他们[再搬家→又搬家了] — her note: 又for something already occurred

[I29] 而且【害得】孟子的学习   correction: 害得 → 影响了   strength: error
  checker's note: 害得 needs a following result clause; 影响了 fits a noun object.
  rule card (haide_harmful_result, Vocabulary): Use 害得 + N/sb. + harmful result (or a harmful clause). The result must be genuinely harmful: neutral events such as 搬家 or 玩儿, and mild feelings such as 不高兴, do not fit after 害得.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: after 害得 + <person/noun>, use a genuinely harmful result; <neutral or mild result> is not harmful enough.  Her terms: 害得 + N/sb. + Harmful result, 害得+Sb.+V., 害得 + clause (harmful result)
  her past correction: 害得[-对]孟子有不好的影响 — her note: 害得+Sb.+V.
  her past correction: 害得对孟子[有→受到了]不好的影响 — her note: 害得+Sb.+V.
  her past correction: 孟母觉得学习⟦害得孟子⟧ — her note: 害得孟子+harmful result, 常常玩

[I30] 而且害得孟子【的】学习   correction: 的 → (delete)   strength: suggestion
  rule card (haide_harmful_result, Vocabulary): Use 害得 + N/sb. + harmful result (or a harmful clause). The result must be genuinely harmful: neutral events such as 搬家 or 玩儿, and mild feelings such as 不高兴, do not fit after 害得.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: after 害得 + <person/noun>, use a genuinely harmful result; <neutral or mild result> is not harmful enough.  Her terms: 害得 + N/sb. + Harmful result, 害得+Sb.+V., 害得 + clause (harmful result)
  her past correction: 孟母觉得学习⟦害得孟子⟧ — her note: 害得孟子+harmful result, 常常玩
  her past correction: 所以孟子[老是→一直]在学习 — her note: “老是“ for something negative, used to complain
  her past correction: 害得对孟子[有→受到了]不好的影响 — her note: 害得+Sb.+V.

items.explanation: 古代 is the location/time setting, so use 在+Place: 在古代.
It would be more natural to add 所以 to show that the people’s crying is the result of their worshipping.
害得 needs a harmful result after the person or noun. 影响了 fits here because 学习 is the noun affected.
It would be more natural to say 孟子学习 without 的 here.
